what: After lane may-suspend wires crates/hir-ty-suspend (docs/v2/plan/lanes/may-suspend.md, Where it lives): a call's targets as codegen dispatches them (lookup_impl_method, dyn methods, Fn* on closures and FnDefs, drop glue, Future::poll of coroutines, builtin derives and Clone, vtables of unsizing casts, reified pointers) is now written in hir-ty-suspend::dispatch, hir-ty-pure::walk, four places in hir-ty-codegen and hir-ty-mir's inliner. Make one module the copy (dispatch.rs is written to be it; moving it to a crate of its own that the others depend on is fine) and move the others onto it. Tell lane may-suspend (window may-suspend) when done.
